title: Shop lists: swap a shop's stock for the season or the story
summary: DMs can build named stock lists, such as Winter goods or Post-siege, and swap any shop's stock to one whenever they choose. The stock it replaces is saved as a list, so you can swap back.
items: Build and edit a library of shop lists in Market under Shop lists.
Save any shop's current stock as a list from the shop's Edit mode.
Swap stock to a list: the shop gets the list's items at its prices and quantities, and the old stock is saved as a list named after the shop and the date.
Coins, merchant purses, what a shop buys and items characters own never change.
Players see only the shop's new stock; your lists stay private.
